items.title: Commission preliminary finds TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act for failing to ensure safe accounts for minors
items.title_zh: 欧委会初步认定 TikTok 未确保未成年人账户安全，违反《数字服务法》
items.summary: The Commission sent preliminary findings on the default visibility and recommendation settings for minors’ public accounts.
items.summary_zh: 欧委会就未成年人公开账户的默认可见范围和推荐设置发出初步认定。

items.title: Commission accepts X's action plan to comply with the Digital Services Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会接受 X 遵守《数字服务法》的行动计划
items.summary: The action plan follows the Commission's non-compliance decision and sets out remediation work on ad transparency and researcher access.
items.summary_zh: 行动计划承接欧委会的不合规决定，覆盖广告透明度与研究者访问的整改工作。

items.title: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok and Meta in breach of their transparency obligations
items.title_zh: 欧委会初步认定 TikTok 与 Meta 违反透明度义务
items.summary: Preliminary findings concern transparency obligations, researcher access and related DSA evidence requests.
items.summary_zh: 初步认定涉及透明度义务、研究者访问以及相关 DSA 证据请求。

items.title: Commission requests information from Apple, Booking.com, Google and Microsoft on financial scams
items.title_zh: 欧委会就金融诈骗向 Apple、Booking.com、Google 与 Microsoft 发出信息请求
items.summary: The requests ask how platforms identify and mitigate fraudulent ads, listings, applications and websites.
items.summary_zh: 信息请求聚焦平台如何识别并降低诈骗广告、房源、应用和网站风险。
